title: US Military Uses Laser Weapon for First Time to Down Cartel-Linked Drones on Mexico Border
detail: US Northern Command's Joint Task Force-Southern Border used an Army Multipurpose High Energy Laser (AMP-HEL) to shoot down three cartel-linked drones in the Rio Grande Valley, southern Texas, overnight on August 25–26, 2026 — the first confirmed combat use of a directed-energy weapon against cartel drones on the border. The military said the drones, detected on consecutive nights, posed a physical threat to US and Customs and Border Protection personnel. Officials said the US has shot down roughly 300 suspected cartel-linked drones along the southern border in 2026, including 100 in August alone, as cartels increasingly use UAS for smuggling and surveillance of law enforcement.

title: Operation Southern Spear's 68th Strike Kills Four Aboard Alleged Drug Boat, Second Strike in Days
detail: Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere carried out the 68th strike of Operation Southern Spear on August 26, 2026, killing four people aboard an alleged drug-smuggling vessel in the Caribbean Sea — the second such strike within days, ending a pause in strikes that had run since June 21, 2026. SOUTHCOM said it had intelligence confirming the vessel was trafficking narcotics along an established Caribbean smuggling route; the exact location was not disclosed. The strike brought the campaign's cumulative toll since September 2025 to at least 227 killed across 68 strikes. Colombian and Venezuelan officials have publicly stated that some of those killed in the campaign were not cartel members, a claim the Trump administration rejects.
